allow: PowerShell($urls = @\("http://localhost:3333/api-json","http://localhost:3333/swagger-json","http://localhost:3333/openapi.json","http://localhost:3333/docs-json","http://localhost:3333/api/docs/json"\); foreach \($u in $urls\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "SUCCESS: $u"; $r.Content | Select-Object -First 500; break } catch { Write-Host "FAIL: $u - $\($_.Exception.Message\)" } })
